notes.title: Added Deck Builder + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
ADDED DECK BUILDER SYSTEM
- Player gets to choose what Items they will encounter on a run, with a minimum requirement of each item category (excluding passives). If any of the minimums are not met, random items will fill those gaps, so players can enjoy a fully random experience still, just by keeping their deck empty, or entirely full. 
- A new option in the main menu to customize your deck, this cannot be changed during a run, it will bring the player to a table on the side of the shop, only items that are owned (either have started with these items or have purchased them already) can be used in a deck. 

BUG FIXES
- If the player were to pick up a boss chest right after picking one up (so two or more in a row shortly) the game would pause and not let the player continue, this has been fixed, the game will now remain paused until the Boss Chest's animation has completed. 

- City Level was playable, it is not finished and is no longer playable, only the park level will be playable in the demo.
